676-progress.name: Drum Fel
676-progress.text:
I have not the time to sharpen my axe, let alone leave the outpost to slay those beasts that would try and slay my kin.

You do not seem to have the experience of a grunt let alone a full-fledged $c, what do you want, $N?
676-progress.title: The Hammer May Fall

92519-accept.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
92519-accept.text:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519-accept.title: Ward Restocking

92519-complete.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
92519-complete.text:
No broken bottles? Yes, you certainly are a better choice for this than Jorell's lackeys.

We'll be able to use these to manage the ills of our patients a while longer.

Since you've proved that you are a natural to field work, I understand injuries come with the territory. Have your choice of the supplies, at least you'll make use of them.
92519-complete.title: Ward Restocking

92519-progress.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
92519-progress.text: If you can get them something for the pain, you can have some of these patients back out the door as fast as they walk in.
92519-progress.title: Ward Restocking

96984-accept.name: Image of Archmage Modera
96984-accept.text:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
96984-accept.title: Heart of Disruption

97539-accept.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
97539-accept.text:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
97539-accept.title: Silky Sutures

97539-complete.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
97539-complete.text:
Splendid spider string. When you're being stitched back together, a little infection is the... least of your concerns.

Ahem, excuse me once again. Doctor humor.

Thanks for helping out the medical ward, $N. If only we could get this kind of help more regularly.
97539-complete.title: Silky Sutures

97539-progress.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
97539-progress.text:
The results are in, I've got good news and bad news for you.

Oh, excuse me.
97539-progress.title: Silky Sutures
